lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgMn5(CuO6)2 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 143) with a 40-atom unit cell and seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Cu, Mg, Mn, and O centers, each surrounded by six geometric neighbors, with Cu–O and Mn–O distances of roughly 1.84–2.46 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show corner-sharing between Cu and Mn octahedra, and between Mg and Mn octahedra.
